guarantees.claim: Each bit i of prng_data_permuted is continuously assigned the value of prng_data at the bit index RndCnstLfsrPerm[i], for i from 0 to EntropyOutputW-1.

assumptions.claim: Each entry RndCnstLfsrPerm[i] must be a valid bit index within the width of prng_data.
assumptions.risk: If any RndCnstLfsrPerm[i] is out of range, the access prng_data[...] would be out of bounds, leading to X propagation or simulation error.

uncertain_points.claim: The permutation correctness depends on RndCnstLfsrPerm entries being valid indices into prng_data. The widths and constant values are defined elsewhere in the module or package; they must be verified to match.
uncertain_points.risk: If mismatched, prng_data_permuted may carry X or incorrect bits, degrading entropy quality.
